summary: John's maternal 4th great-grandmother per the tree; mother of Nicola Cognetta.
bio: Tree: Domenica Malvaso (1781-1848), wife of Francesco Cognetta; parents Nicola Malvaso (b. 1740) + Catarina Croce (b. 1742). Malvaso is concentrated in Acquaro, the comune adjacent to Dasà (5 of 13 US arrivals per paese.app), and occurs in Dasà in 1854-55 (Antenati index). Her 1848 death act should be in the Dasà Morti (civil registration from 1809).
openQuestions: Dasà Morti 1848 death act (names parents and husband)
